top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The infant pack n plays had an added soft mattress. The added mattress did not come with the pack n plays.     Note: This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram (26 TAC §746.5207(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency evacuation diagrams that are posted in the classroom do not indicate the relocation center outside of the child care center or the shelter in place location(s).

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CCR observed stationary equipment positioned less than six feet from the perimeter.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §744.603(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a child in care at the time of the inspection who did not have any records. The child also had a known allergy.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - As Amended in Writing by Child's Health Care Professional (26 TAC §744.2655(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the proper medication in care for the child who requires an EpiPen.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Plan-Emergency plan for diagnosed child, signed by health care professional and parent (26 TAC §744.2669)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children with food allergies did not have a food allergy plan.
